highlights: Answer paused Agent Chat and Project Chat questions from persistent, expandable notifications anywhere in the Portal, with a distinct alert sound and no navigation.
Durable chat coordination keeps long turns, steering, tool history, pending input, and reconnect replay bounded and tied to the exact user, run, and conversation.
Project Chat runs in attested project-bound containers with controlled public egress; preserved 3.x Projects remain fail-closed until their lineage is reconciled safely.
Transactional App deployment, broader backups, Keep-Data reconnect, running-App restoration, and rollback protect working sources and recorded process intent across maintenance.
Signed Dashboard updates show verified release details, require backup preflight, bind source lineage to exact contents, and roll back candidates that fail migration or health checks.
